entries.appliesTo: health carriers (and public-employee health plans, and contracted health care benefit managers) using AI in prior authorization determinations

dutySources.human-review: Sec. 2(3)(a) — 'Algorithms may be used to process and approve prior authorization requests, but may not be used without human review to deny care based on a determination of medical necessity.'
dutySources.risk-program: Sec. 2(3)(b) — 'A carrier that uses artificial intelligence for the purpose of prior authorization or prior authorization functions, based in whole or in part on medical necessity, … shall ensure all of the following'; (vi) 'The policies and procedures for using artificial intelligence are open to audit by the office of the insurance commissioner under chapter 48.37 RCW'
dutySources.impact-assessment: Sec. 2(3)(b)(vii) — 'The artificial intelligence's performance, use, and outcomes are periodically reviewed by the carrier to maximize accuracy and reliability'
dutySources.registration-filing: Sec. 8(1) — 'the carrier shall report to the commissioner the following aggregated and deidentified data related to the carrier's prior authorization practices and experience for the prior plan year'; (1)(a)(i) 'The percentage of total denials that were aided by artificial intelligence'

exposure.enforcer: office-of-insurance-commissioner (AI policies/procedures open to audit under ch. 48.37 RCW; commissioner may adopt rules)

sources.humanReview: Sec. 2(3)(a) — 'Only a licensed physician or a licensed health professional working within their scope of practice may deny a prior authorization request based on medical necessity. … may not be used without human review to deny care based on a determination of medical necessity.'
sources.decisionsCovered: Sec. 2(3)(b) — 'uses artificial intelligence for the purpose of prior authorization or prior authorization functions, based in whole or in part on medical necessity'
sources.aiSoleBasis: Sec. 2(3)(a) — 'Artificial intelligence shall not be the sole means used to deny, delay, or modify health care services.'
sources.enforcer: Sec. 2(3)(b)(vi) — 'The policies and procedures for using artificial intelligence are open to audit by the office of the insurance commissioner under chapter 48.37 RCW'; Sec. 2(7) — 'The commissioner may adopt any rules necessary to implement this section.'

flags: Dual-version drafting: Sec. 2 (RCW 48.43.830) and Sec. 6 (RCW 48.43.535) expire January 1, 2027 (Sec. 9); Secs. 3 and 7 are parallel reenactments taking effect January 1, 2027 (Sec. 10) — the AI provisions are identical across versions.

Sec. 4 applies the same standards to health plans offered to public employees, retirees, and dependents under RCW 41.05 (rules by the health care authority, not the commissioner) — coded company per category rule; public-employee-plan applicability noted here.

Sec. 3(3)(b)(i)-(viii) AI-use conditions include requirements with no listed param/duty: determinations must be based on the enrollee's individual clinical history/circumstances and not 'solely on a group data set'; no discrimination 'directly or indirectly'; patient data 'not used beyond its intended and stated purpose' (cross-references ch. 70.02 RCW and HIPAA).

registration-filing covers the annual prior-authorization data report to the commissioner (Sec. 8), which includes the percentage of denials aided by AI; it applies only to carriers 'that has written at least one percent of the total accident and health insurance premiums' (Sec. 8(1)).

Substantial non-AI provisions in the same prior-auth regime: determination/notification timeframes and clinical-review-criteria standards (Secs. 2-4(1)); prior authorization API and interoperable e-process requirements (Secs. 2-4(4)); denial notices must include reviewing provider's credentials (Secs. 2-4(1)(e)); prohibition on retrospective denial/modification of approved prior authorizations with 1%-per-month interest on wrongly denied claims (Sec. 5); independent review organization process (Secs. 6-7).
No penalty amounts stated anywhere in the act — exposure carries enforcer only (audit/rulemaking authority quotes).
